When we looked at our own cohort, the students who moved fastest weren't the ones who arrived with the highest entrance rank. They were the ones who had already broken something and fixed it.

That changed how we run first year. Less lecturing, more shipping. Every semester ends with something that runs.

It is not a comfortable way to teach. It is a very good way to learn.
